summary: Candidate is a distinct session_skill for LLM event lifecycle capture with structured error handling. It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (parallel URL fetch, zone-weighted retrieval, LLM alignment evaluation). Peer candidates (Agent Execution Session Recording, AgentOps Session Replay, Cost Monitoring) operate at different stages (execution_setup, setup, monitoring) and address different concerns (agent behavior, client initialization, budget tracking). This candidate is response_processing stage focused on LLM request-response event capture with exception-to-ErrorEvent conversion—a unique capability not present in registry.
